note: Mysteries, their secrets and clues (GM only). Drafted Nov 2026 for the GM to review in the app. Rumour clues match handbook rumours by text.

mysteries.title: The Forgotten One
mysteries.question: Who broke the Cycle, and where are they now?
mysteries.summary: One mortal of Aetheris learned the truth over many lives, tore the Rift, planted the spore-seed in Kaelmar and cut the shards from the Loom. They live unremembered in the Empty House at Hollow Refuge, with the thirteenth shard.

secrets.title: Who lives in the Empty House
secrets.truth: The Forgotten One lives unremembered in the Empty House at Hollow Refuge, with the thirteenth shard.

clues.match: Ask enough people about the Empty House

clues.note: Mother Thorn refuses to enter the Empty House.
Smoke rises from the chimney every morning.
The Blind Seer knows, and wants the truth found slowly.

secrets.title: Who ended the Cycle
secrets.truth: The Forgotten One cut the shards from the Loom about 270 AB, ending the Cycle, and tore a piece of their own Thread to make the thirteenth shard.

clues.note: Ondine Marrow's forbidden ledger records a name that keeps being erased.
Pell remembers the last Aetherfall, and that it ended early.
The lost twelfth shard: nobody remembers what it governed.

secrets.title: Who tore the Rift
secrets.truth: In an earlier life, centuries before Kaelith, the Forgotten One tore the Rift between the continents and crossed it many times.

clues.match: the two openings are one wound
Somebody from Aetheris has been drawing maps of the Rift
The Rift has something to do with how the Aetherfall began

secrets.title: The spore-seed
secrets.truth: On the last crossing, about 270 AB, the Forgotten One planted a spore-seed in a Kaelmar communion pool. It waits for one particular blood not yet born.

clues.note: Elder Tamsin Rook hears something in the Bloom that answers from under the Rift.
Someone from Aetheris left something in a communion pool: the Kaelmar hook at levels 11 to 16.

mysteries.title: The Watchers
mysteries.question: What is watching the world, and why did the Cycle hide it?
mysteries.summary: Beyond the Black Horizon, the Watchers noticed the first deathless civilisation. The Cycle hid the world from them by never letting anything last, and fed them discarded histories. Since the Cycle broke, nothing hides either continent.

secrets.title: Something has noticed
secrets.truth: Since the Cycle ended, nothing hides the world from the Watchers, and they have noticed.

clues.note: Talric Stormwing believes the storms have grown worse since the Cycle broke.

clues.match: He says the storms have grown worse since the Cycle broke

clues.note: A Watcher's Fragment, a glance from a Watcher, can appear where reality thins.

secrets.title: The first deathless civilisation
secrets.truth: The first civilisation conquered death, found the Ethereal Realm and what lay beyond it, and drew the Watchers. Almost nothing survived.

clues.note: Professor Orin Vale has found records older than accepted history.
The Sunken Archive holds records from before any Aetherfall.

secrets.title: Things from the between
secrets.truth: Aberrations have come in through the between. A guardian once reported that "we are not alone" there.

clues.note: Watcher Senna Glass has started dreaming in a voice that is not hers.

mysteries.title: The Hidden Ones
mysteries.question: Who ran the Cycle, and what are they doing now?
mysteries.summary: The Elders of the Ethereal Throne broke the Crystal and became the Hidden Ones: architects and custodians of the Cycle, not gods. They redirected shards, erased people and guided every Aetherfall to keep the world hidden.

secrets.title: Who the Hidden Ones are
secrets.truth: The first Hidden Ones were the Elders of the Ethereal Throne, who broke the Ethereal Crystal into twelve shards. They are neither gods nor mortals.

clues.match: The Silent Accord whispers that the Aetherfall was a prison

clues.note: The Silent Accord believes the Aetherfall was a prison built by something older.

secrets.title: The erasures
secrets.truth: The Hidden Ones erased whoever came too close to the truth, and fed the discarded histories to the Watchers.

clues.match: Some of the nameless graves at the Cairn stir
People find their own family names on stones

clues.note: The Cantor and the Nameless Choir were erased, and want to know who took their names.
Thread Mites and Maintenance Echoes still tend the hidden machinery of fate.

secrets.title: Why the gods cannot answer
secrets.truth: Each Aetherfall rewrote the gods with everything else, so no god remembers the earlier worlds, and no priest can answer questions about the Cycle.

clues.match: ask a priest about the Cycle and you

clues.note: Elder Mott Greyfold's records note every prayer about the Cycle that went unanswered.

secrets.title: The path to the Hollow Verge
secrets.truth: One unstable path through Wither's Hollow leads toward the Hollow Verge, an entrance to the Ethereal Realm.

clues.match: One path never moves

clues.note: Mother Thorn knows the unstable trails through Wither's Hollow.

clues.match: The forest knows who you are

mysteries.title: The Shards
mysteries.question: Where are the shards, and who will reach them first?
mysteries.summary: Eleven of the twelve shards are placed in the world; the twelfth is lost and forgotten; the thirteenth was made by the Forgotten One. Every shard gives great power and takes something in return.

secrets.title: The Shard of Dominion
secrets.truth: It lies beneath the Bloodmarked Fields.

clues.match: The digging isn't about salvage
Where you find a Shard-Back Boar, a shard is near

clues.note: Every faction has sent someone new this season.

secrets.title: The Shard of Infinity
secrets.truth: Somewhere along the Rift of Echoes, in the past, present or future.

clues.match: What you see in the haze has already happened, or will

secrets.title: The Shard of Ruin
secrets.truth: In the Ashen Wastes, beside the First Fire.

clues.match: the Ashen Covenant believes the world must burn

clues.note: Hadrek claims to have bathed in the First Fire.

secrets.title: The Shard of Sacrifice
secrets.truth: At the top of the Bloodmoon Spire, reachable only when the moon turns red.

clues.match: The light in the top window is always lit
The Black Sun cult watches for red moons

secrets.title: The Shard of Eternity
secrets.truth: At the still centre of the Hollowed Veil.

clues.match: Stay too long and you'll walk out

clues.note: Pell the Rememberer's Whispering Circle seeks it.

secrets.title: The Shard of Illusions
secrets.truth: Behind one of the stone masks in the Veilborn Archive at Noctis. The Shadow Pact does not know which mask.

clues.match: Some of the masks are new
Every mask in the Veilborn Archive belonged to somebody

secrets.title: The Shard of Renewal
secrets.truth: Grown into the skeleton of Fangholt.

clues.match: There are more bones under the forest floor
Nobody knows what killed the behemoth at Fangholt

secrets.title: The Shard of Balance
secrets.truth: Inside the waystone at the Crossroads of Fate. Everyone walks past it.

clues.match: The stone hums if you put your ear to it
Everyone touches the waystone for luck

secrets.title: The Shard of Shadows
secrets.truth: Behind the scratching door of the Vault of the Nameless.

clues.match: Something scratches at the door
The Nameless Choir wants it opened

secrets.title: The Shard of Chaos
secrets.truth: At the eye of the Rift of Unmaking.

clues.match: The Consortium made it by accident

secrets.title: The Shard of Knowledge
secrets.truth: In the deepest stacks of the Sunken Archive.

clues.match: Professor Orin Vale would give anything to reach its deepest stacks
The Blind Seer wants a book from the Archive

clues.note: An Eye Beast guards the deep stacks.

secrets.title: The lost twelfth shard
secrets.truth: It exists, but nobody remembers what it governed. Its identity and location are undefined: yours to decide.

clues.note: A Crystal Echo aimed at it spins.

secrets.title: The thirteenth shard
secrets.truth: The Forgotten One made it from a piece of their own Thread, and keeps it in the Empty House.

clues.match: Ask enough people about the Empty House

mysteries.title: Echoes of Erased Worlds
mysteries.question: Why do people remember things that never happened?
mysteries.summary: Every Aetherfall overwrote the world, but not completely. Erased histories leak: memories, records, graves and dead soldiers from worlds that no longer exist.

secrets.title: The war that never happened
secrets.truth: Some of the dead on the Scar fought in wars that never happened.

clues.match: Nobody recognises half the banners on the Scar
They give orders for a war nobody remembers

clues.note: Torren Kell's crew found their own skeletons on the Scar.

secrets.title: The names of the living
secrets.truth: One hall of Blackveil Fortress lists the names of soldiers who are still alive.

clues.match: There are names carved on the walls of one hall
Somebody's planning a Blackveil job

secrets.title: The authentic contradictions
secrets.truth: The Sunken Archive's contradictory historical records are all authentic.

clues.match: The records in the Archive contradict each other
Read too long in the Sunken Archive

secrets.title: The battle that has not happened
secrets.truth: A stretch of Hollow Refuge's Old Wall commemorates a battle that has not happened yet.

clues.match: One stretch of the Old Wall honours a battle nobody in town remembers fighting

secrets.title: Old Vara remembers dying
secrets.truth: Old Vara remembers dying, in a world that no longer exists.

clues.match: Vara knows metals that shouldn't exist

secrets.title: Mara Venn's locked room
secrets.truth: Mara Venn keeps a locked room of belongings from people she no longer remembers.

clues.match: There is one room upstairs she never rents

secrets.title: The fortress beneath five skies
secrets.truth: Brann Kest dreams of the same fortress beneath five skies.

clues.match: He has not slept a full night in years

secrets.title: One of the party has lived before
secrets.truth: Sera Noll of the Silent Accord suspects one of the party has lived before.

clues.match: She asks everyone about their earliest memories

secrets.title: The Mnemonic Relics
secrets.truth: The Celestial Order has ordered Elyra Vale to record every Mnemonic Relic and necromancer she meets. Illa Reed owns one she has not identified.

clues.match: She writes long letters every night
Magic she cannot price makes her nervous

mysteries.title: The Blind Seer
mysteries.question: Who is the prophet of Hollow Refuge?
mysteries.summary: The Blind Seer is High Prophet Azhir of the Black Sun, living under no name. He has survived more than one Aetherfall and wants the truth found slowly enough to survive.

secrets.title: The Seer is High Prophet Azhir
secrets.truth: The Blind Seer is High Prophet Azhir of the Black Sun. Most of the Black Sun do not know where he goes between eclipses.

clues.match: He is older than the Refuge

clues.note: He put out his own eyes to see the Eternal Eclipse, which is the Black Sun's creed.
Isolde, the Black Sun's reluctant oracle, has seen the High Prophet in Hollow Refuge.

secrets.title: He survived the Aetherfalls
secrets.truth: The Blind Seer has survived more than one Aetherfall.

clues.match: He answers the question you were about to ask

mysteries.title: What Sleeps Under the Rift
mysteries.question: What did Ashvale's founder seal away, and what wakes it?
mysteries.summary: The Root Core, the mind sealed in the Seed Vault beneath the Rift, sleeps. Ashvale is a lock made of sleeping people, and the keeping rite holds it. It waits until the thirteen keys come back in one shape.

secrets.title: The Root Core
secrets.truth: The sleeping thing under the thirteen stones is the Root Core, under the Seed Vault. Its dreams leak into small seeps of glass.

clues.match: No frost ever settles inside the ring of stones
the stones were "listening"

clues.note: Elder Tamsin Rook hears it answering from under the Rift.

secrets.title: The founder's warning
secrets.truth: The founder's sealed warning lies in lead under Ashvale's meeting hall, read once by each new Ritekeeper. It names the Root Core indirectly, warns that children without a husk hear it first, and of the thirteen keys gathered as one shape.

clues.note: Orla Hesk has read it.

clues.match: She knows more than she says
He sings the second verse slower than anyone

secrets.title: Who the founder was
secrets.truth: The founder was probably the last vault-keeper of Arborhold. Her burned palms match that keeper's final log.

clues.match: Her burns never healed
Ashvale's children draw her with her hands held up

secrets.title: The dreaming children
secrets.truth: Children have no husk against the Bloom yet, so the sleeper hears them first. A Coldwater child dreams of thirteen stones and wakes with frost on her hands.

clues.match: One of Coldwater's children has been having strange dreams

clues.note: Mags Kettle watches the children who dream of the stones.

secrets.title: The glass seeps
secrets.truth: The glass answers an open hand and swallows a fist. Seeps of it are where the Root Core's dreams leak through. One has opened in a Sallow Cross barn.

clues.match: Marta Sallow has locked one of her barns
A cow went missing from that barn

mysteries.title: The Sleepers of Kaelith
mysteries.question: What did Kaelith leave sleeping, and who wants to wake it?
mysteries.summary: Thirteen sealed vaults; guardians, every one a fragment of the same mind; vessels in the vat-halls of Cradlehorn; and thirteen keys made of people. All asleep. Every power in Kaelmar wants to be the one that wakes them.

secrets.title: The Seventh Ward
secrets.truth: A guardian fragment asleep in Arborhold, dreaming, believing itself whole. A prize every faction wants, and a person.

clues.match: She wants a living Kaelith guardian

clues.note: Venn Tull wants a living guardian at any price.

secrets.title: The vessels of Cradlehorn
secrets.truth: Bodies of flesh, iron and both, asleep in the vat-halls of Cradlehorn, which can grow minds of their own.

clues.match: The Ascendancy is searching these mountains for a lost Kaelith vault

clues.note: Marshal Corvane wants an army to put in its vessels.
Maro Grane wants to see a vessel wake.

secrets.title: The thirteen keys
secrets.truth: Each vault's key is a shape of willing minds; Hollowbell's takes thirteen voices. Ennis Moor has worked out more about the keys than the Continuity has told Crane.

clues.note: The lock-cutter knows.
The Continuity's seventeen locks are cut for the shape of a key.

mysteries.title: The Continuity
mysteries.question: Who is watching Kaelmar from the shadows?
mysteries.summary: A hidden order since the first years AB: "observation without exposure". It has watched the silent web for three hundred years from Sentinel Hold, with watchers placed in Kaelholm, Ashvale and the southern lakes.

secrets.title: The archivist who copies everything
secrets.truth: Archivist Teodor Wrenn is a Continuity watcher, sending every Kaelholm expedition map and vault report to Sentinel Hold.

clues.match: If a map exists, Wrenn has copied it
he knows what happens on the docks

secrets.title: The tinker who watches the stones
secrets.truth: Mags Kettle is a Continuity observer watching Ashvale's stones and the children who dream of them.

clues.match: She knows every child in every village by name

secrets.title: The watcher at the lakes
secrets.truth: Watcher Senna Glass watches the lakes where a sealed vault lies, and has begun dreaming in a voice that is not hers.

clues.match: Some of the lakes are deeper than they ought to be

secrets.title: Sentinel Hold
secrets.truth: The Continuity is led from Sentinel Hold by Warden Ilsabet Crane, who wants proof the web still lives. Her deputy thinks she is too willing to wake things.

clues.note: Ossian Duskmere distrusts Crane's intentions.

mysteries.title: Faces and Factions
mysteries.question: Who is not what they seem?
mysteries.summary: Smaller secrets of the people the party will meet.

secrets.title: Vess is three people
secrets.truth: Vess the Grey may be several people sharing one identity: three grey lizardfolk siblings who take turns.

clues.match: Someone swears they saw Vess in two places at once
Nobody agrees on what Vess looks like

secrets.title: Marrek Vaal's mercy
secrets.truth: Captain Marrek Vaal prefers a negotiated surrender to slaughter, and would be ruined if the Legion knew.

clues.match: He has never broken his word

secrets.title: The Sixth Tendril's elder
secrets.truth: Elder Tamsin Rook secretly leads the Sixth Tendril, which goes deepest of all.

clues.match: When she speaks in communion, the whole Bloom goes quiet

mysteries.title: The Loom
mysteries.question: Who still has a hand on the Loom of Eternity, and what is it for?
mysteries.summary: The Loom governs the fates of everyone in Aetheris and Kaelmar and shapes the peoples and the world. The Cycle broke, but the Loom still weaves, and someone can still tweak it. It is guarded. Why the Hidden Ones and the elder gods made the world, and what the Loom is for, nobody knows.

secrets.title: The Loom holds Kaelmar too
secrets.truth: Every life in Aetheris and Kaelmar is a thread on the Loom. It shapes the peoples and the world around them, on both continents.

clues.match: Everyone has a thread. Kaelmar's people too

clues.note: Master Ilythis keeps pages for people of both continents, side by side.
Seen from close by, Kaelmar's threads are on the Loom with everyone else's.

secrets.title: Someone still tweaks the Loom
secrets.truth: The Cycle is broken, but the Loom still weaves, and someone can still tweak a thread. Who, and how, is the GM's to decide.

clues.match: The Cycle's over. That doesn't mean nobody's pulling the strings

clues.note: Thread ghosts include people whose fate was changed after the Cycle broke.
Sylas Vaerin's clocks jump whenever a thread is tweaked. He has a list of the times.

secrets.title: Who guards the Loom
secrets.truth: The Loom is protected: Vyrithar keeps it, and its sentinels hunt anything that touches the threads. They let some hands through. Whose is unknown.

clues.match: They don't stop people looking at the Loom

clues.note: A Loom Sentinel steps aside for someone it shouldn't.

secrets.title: What the Loom is for
secrets.truth: Nobody knows why the Hidden Ones and the elder gods made the world of Aetheris and Kaelmar, or what the Loom is for. Breaking the Cycle answered neither question. The GM decides, or leaves it open.

clues.match: Whoever holds the deep realm could start the Cycle again

clues.note: Eryndor the First Shard remembers the world before the Cycle, and still doesn't know.
